 Galveston County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0021
 Megan Gutierrez, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
October 24, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Laura Bryant, Dunn & Acosta LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff Megan Gutierrez is an individual residing in Texas who was operating a passenger vehicle at the time of the collision
described below. Defednant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to transact business in the State of Texas, which issued
the policy under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and against which this action is brought.
FACTS
On October 18, 2023, Plaintiff was driving through a signalized intersection in Sugar Land when another vehicle entered the
intersection from a cross street and struck the side of Plaintiff's vehicle. The impact pushed Plaintiff's car sideways and caused
substantial damage to the driver's side. Plaintiff reported the collision promptly and submitted documentation of the loss to
Defendant. Defendant has not paid the claim in an amount sufficient to cover Plaintiff's medical treatment and property damage,
and has delayed its evaluation without adequate explanation.
NEGLIGENCE
Defendant, as the insurer obligated to pay covered benefits under the policy, owed Plaintiff a duty to investigate the claim in good
faith, to evaluate it fairly, and to pay amounts owed once liability became reasonably clear. Defendant breached that duty by
failing to conduct a reasonable investigation, by unreasonably delaying payment, and by offering a settlement that did not reflect
the nature and extent of Plaintiff's injuries. These failures violate the duties imposed under Chapter 541 and Chapter 542 of the
Texas Insurance Code.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision and Defendant's conduct, Plaintiff sustained a shoulder injury requiring medical evaluation,
imaging, and ongoing treatment, and has experienced pain, limited range of motion, and lost time from daily activities. Plaintiff
has also incurred medical expenses and loss of use of the vehicle. Plaintiff seeks recovery of policy benefits, statutory interest,
attorney's fees, and additional damages as permitted by law, in an amount of $176,000.00.
